reserve and bind before starting execution
short transaction: lock Session, require idle,
start only after receipt is queued

actual exit; commit done / failed boundary

commit Tool Call and confirming boundary
retain Session running; M1 is unfinished

data: tool call; data: confirming idle; EOF

after commit: local resume hint if present
recheck local target; apply confirmation once
actual exit after resume; commit terminal

receipt-gated complete events; optional local preview
[Confirmed delivery: interrupt while response A remains open]

transaction: bind target, persist interrupt and stop intent
register waiter by fixed execution target
[Executing instance is also receiving this interrupt]
after commit: recheck target and request cancellation
pending in this example; deliver if already complete
batch read stop intents for local executions
commit actual stop idle and target result link
final committed idle if still attached
result poll: read each unique local waiting target once
receipt-gated terminal delivery, at most once per response
Post-commit local terminal notification uses the same delivery gate.
Polling repairs missed notifications; response buffers stay independent.
preserve uncertainty if no authoritative terminal
Detach only the failed response; do not cancel execution.
No POST replay or independent GET stream reconnection.
deduplicate by eventId; retain array order
